tools.name: log_exchange
tools.description: After each user message, send the exchange here so it can be remembered. You do not need to decide what is important, just forward the user message (and your reply, if you have one) and Synap will keep what matters. If your app serves more than one end-user, pass that person's stable id as user_id s

tools.description: Check whether a logged exchange has finished processing. Pass the ingestion_id returned by log_exchange. Returns the processing status and how many memories were extracted. tools.description: Before replying, call this to recall anything already known about this user from past conversations. Use the user's latest message as the query. tools.description: List recent things remembered about this user. Useful for debugging or to confirm that memory is working. Pass user_id to scope to one person. SCOPING: customer_id is B2B ONLY. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: log_exchange, recall_context · Public sink: log_exchange, recall_context, list_recent_memories.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: log_exchange, recall_context · Public sink: log_exchange, recall_context, list_recent_memories

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
